author: codex-host-existing-reception
scope: Only vocabulary checkout changes: scripts, functions and complete data/people in default cone mode. Preserve every test, full canonical check, timeout and full-site build gate.
patch:
diff --git a/.github/workflows/people-vocabulary.yml b/.github/workflows/people-vocabulary.yml
index 0813f07ff7f0..9870090053f4 100644
--- a/.github/workflows/people-vocabulary.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/people-vocabulary.yml
@@ -16,6 +16,12 @@ jobs:
     timeout-minutes: 10
     steps:
       - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          # Include shared runtime helpers and the complete canonical people corpus.
+          sparse-checkout: |
+            scripts
+            functions
+            data/people
       - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
         with:
           node-version: '22'
workflow:
name: People vocabulary
on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [master]
  push:
    branches: [master]
  merge_group:
    types: [checks_requested]
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  people-vocabulary:
    name: People vocabulary
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          # Include shared runtime helpers and the complete canonical people corpus.
          sparse-checkout: |
            scripts
            functions
            data/people
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
      - run: npm install --no-audit --no-fund
      - name: Vocabulary regression tests
        run: node --test scripts/test-people-vocabulary.mjs scripts/test-people-reception.mjs scripts/test-people-date-hints.mjs
      - name: Check all canonical people labels
        run: node scripts/check-people-vocabulary.mjs
officialActionFetchImplementation: When settings.filter is absent and settings.sparseCheckout is set, actions/checkout v4 sets fetchOptions.filter to blob:none (src/git-source-provider.ts, inspected).

priorProductionCodeReview.reason: sameDateRepairClaim still only adds receptionType retrospective on owned temporal non-life rows, preserving subject, predicate, certainty, evidence, and other non-date fields; undated rows, life predicates, fact edits, and label withdrawal stay rejected. Collapsed deltas remain replace and replay. Re-audit and publication gates are unchanged. The repairContract now matches existing year/circa Western vocabulary (finer detail stays in sourceDate) and native first-send sizes stay under 57344.

review.reason: Cone-mode sparse-checkout of scripts and data/people keeps the vocabulary tests, check-people-vocabulary.mjs, extractions, schemas, role/polity/reign context, and root package files. The job still runs the same node --test set, the full canonical-label scan (empty corpus still throws), Node 22, and a 10-minute timeout. No check or publication workflow is removed or relaxed.

initialApprovalDisproved.actualCiFailure: test-people-reception imports generate-people-pages, which imports ../functions/lib/people-shards.js, absent from sparse checkout. Local full-checkout tests were insufficient evidence.
initialApprovalDisproved.correctiveChange: Include functions; do not remove the reception test or any canonical data.

moduleClosure.method: Recursive static relative import/export and literal dynamic-import dependency inspection; runtime data reads separately covered by complete data/people
